Improving how a technology organization delivers

Building the organizational foundations for more consistent execution.

The objective

Improve the effectiveness and delivery maturity of a major Australian telecommunications business’s technology organization.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led an improvement programme covering the business case, organizational structure, processes, accountability, communications, performance measures and programme governance.

The outcome

The programme supported transformation towards a CMMI Level 5 maturity objective. The CV does not establish whether that maturity level was formally achieved.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Organizing people, processes and governance around a shared delivery objective.
